title: Account locked — too many failed login attempts
content: If your account is locked after several incorrect password attempts, wait 30 minutes and try again, or use the 'Forgot password' link on the login page to reset your password immediately via an emailed link. This is fully self-service — no need to contact support.

title: Account locked — suspicious activity flag
content: If your account was locked due to a suspicious-activity flag (unusual location, new device, or an admin-triggered security hold), it cannot be unlocked by resetting your password. You must contact support directly so an agent can verify your identity manually before restoring access.

title: Refund policy — duplicate charges
content: Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No ticket is required, but you're welcome to ask support to confirm a specific refund is in progress.

title: Refund policy — subscription cancellation
content: You can cancel your subscription at any time from Account Settings > Billing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not issue partial refunds for unused days in the current period.

title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

title: Two-factor authentication setup
content: Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) and enter the 6-digit code to confirm setup. Save the backup codes shown at the end in a safe place.

title: Changing your billing email address
content: To change the email address that receives invoices, go to Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email field. This does not change your login email.

title: API rate limits
content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

title: Mobile app push notifications not arriving
content: If push notifications aren't arriving on mobile, first check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone's OS-level settings (Settings > Notifications on iOS, or App info > Notifications on Android). In-app notification toggles only work if OS-level permission is also granted.

title: Data export / GDPR requests
content: To request a full export of your account data for GDPR or personal record-keeping purposes, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link to your account email.

title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

title: Known issue: dashboard slow to load with 10,000+ rows
content: Dashboards with more than 10,000 rows currently load slowly because pagination is not yet applied server-side. Workaround: filter the dashboard by date range to reduce the row count. A server-side pagination fix is on the roadmap but has no committed release date.

title: Adding and removing team members
content: Admins can add or remove team members from Account Settings > Team. Removing a member immediately revokes their access; there is no confirmation delay. Each member's role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) can be changed from the same screen.

title: Supported browsers
content: The web app officially supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported. Some layout issues may appear on unsupported browsers.
